headline: Athletic after Levante: still favourites, but only for a narrow win
summary: Athletic Club are back at San Mamés on Sunday with just 1 win from their last 5 league games, after a 1-3 defeat at Levante in midweek. The news is mixed: Nico Williams returns to the squad after injury, while Sancet is doubtful, leaving the central creative role open. Getafe won both meetings last season, but they create very little — 0.69 expected goals per game. That is why Athletic stay clear favourites at 58.8%, with only 2.14 goals expected: a narrow, controlled home win rather than a big one.
read: Athletic come home to San Mamés four days after a 3-1 defeat at Levante, with Nico Williams back in the squad but Sancet doubtful. The market still makes them clear favourites — 58.8% to Getafe's 17.5% — while the goal line has slipped to 2.14, so a controlled, low-scoring home win is the picture.

facts.fact: Athletic lost 3-1 at Levante on October 21, their first defeat at that ground since 2018.
facts.meaning: They come back to San Mamés needing a reaction after conceding three in a rescheduled midweek game.

facts.fact: Nico Williams has returned to group training and is back in Athletic's squad after injury.
facts.meaning: A first-choice wide attacker is available again for a side that has scored five goals in its last five league games.

facts.fact: Athletic are 58.8% favourites at home; Getafe's chance is 17.5%.
facts.meaning: The market makes Athletic more than three times as likely to win as Getafe.

facts.fact: The market's 50/50 handicap line is -0.85, with the main line at -0.75.
facts.meaning: Athletic are rated about 0.85 goals better — a narrow home win is the expected shape, not a rout.

facts.fact: Oihan Sancet needs more time before returning and is doubtful for the Getafe match.
facts.meaning: Athletic's creative central role is uncertain, which puts more weight on Nico Williams' comeback.

facts.fact: Getafe have averaged 0.69 xG per game across their last five, against 1.44 conceded.
facts.meaning: They create very little, so their games stay tight and low-scoring — a 1-1 with Rayo and a 1-1 in Europe are the recent pattern.

facts.fact: The market's 50/50 goal line has slipped from 2.2 to 2.14, with Over 2.25 at 46.4%.
facts.meaning: The market leans under three goals — a controlled home win rather than an open game.

facts.fact: Getafe won 1-0 at San Mamés the last time these sides met there, in October 2025.
facts.meaning: The recent head-to-head favours the underdog — Getafe also won the return at home in April.

sources.fact: Nico Williams has returned to group training and is back in Athletic's squad after injury.
Athletic lost 3-1 away at Levante on October 21, their first defeat at the Ciutat de Valencia since 2018.
Athletic coach Terzić said his side must stop giving away silly balls in midfield, blaming two midfield losses for the Levante defeat.
Oihan Sancet needs more time before returning and his availability for the Getafe match is doubtful.
Athletic drew 0-0 away at Valencia in their previous La Liga match.
Before their rescheduled Levante match, Athletic sat 11th in La Liga with 9 points.
Ivan Azon has returned to full team training after recovering from discomfort, giving Getafe another attacking option for the Athletic match.
Dani Carvajal has joined Getafe after leaving Real Madrid and made his debut with a first start and an ovation from the home fans.
